name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: An Agent Skill Marketplace that audits how discoverable, machine-readable, and engaging a website is to AI agents and answer engines, and returns one evidence-backed JSON report.

skills.summary: Validates the input site, runs the shared crawl, invokes the six specialized audits, and assembles the final validated report. This is the only skill an end user calls directly.
Crawlability and render-fidelity: robots.txt, sitemap, canonical hygiene, broken links, and JS-dependent content detection.
schema.org coverage and correctness: JSON-LD/Microdata/RDFa presence, completeness, validity, and consistency with visible content.
Whether a machine can extract who/what/who-for/where from the site's actual machine-readable text, independent of structured data.
Publication/modification date signals, staleness, and cross-page fact consistency, with explicit limitations where external corroboration is unavailable.
Whether the site establishes a single, unambiguous organizational identity an AI system could not confuse with another entity.
On-site engagement: homepage orientation, clear next actions, internal-linking health, and dead ends.
Deduplicates findings by root cause, refines recommendations (optionally via LLM synthesis), prioritizes, and assembles the final schema-valid report.
